propositions: Compaction must be triggered automatically in environments without CI and without local cron, via both a scheduled sweep (where CI exists) and an operation-linked fallback (on close path) that does not reintroduce the 13m53s store lock hold from the P0 fix.

Selection for sweep must choose tickets for re-folding either by backfill (no SNAPSHOT and at least one foldable event) or by recurrence (foldable count exceeds threshold), using the same horizon predicate as the fold to prevent selecting tickets with only young events.

Honest counting must observe artifact changes (SNAPSHOT file presence before and after) rather than return codes, and best-effort push must occur on every non-dry-run, non-no-commit invocation to prevent stranding earlier unpushed writes.

Two concurrent folds from separate clones must merge cleanly with both snapshots preserved and identical event reduction, enabled by timestamped advisory lock discipline reusing the drain lock's v2 stamp and stale-owner detection.

An operation-linked fallback trigger on the close path (after lock release and push) must spawn a detached worker via O(1) checks for either the just-closed ticket satisfying selection or a stale sweep-timestamp file, with tri-state config knob for async/inline/off behavior.

The foldable event count selection must exclude UNKNOWN-TYPE events (which the fold filters) and exclude SNAPSHOT.json artifacts (which represent already-folded state, not pending work) to prevent permanent churn on low thresholds.
